name: CRMax – CRM AI Automated to the Max
author: demfilz

sections.description:
CRMax – CRM AI Automated to the Max links your WordPress website to your CRMax account so every lead your site captures lands in your CRM automatically – no copy-paste, no missed enquiries.

Enter your CRMax API token once, and the plugin will:

  • Sync form submissions from Contact Form 7, WPForms, Gravity Forms, Elementor Pro Forms and Fluent Forms. Names, emails, phone numbers and companies are detected automatically; anything else is stored as custom fields so no data is lost.
  • Sync users – new registrations and profile updates become contacts, optionally tagged with their role. A bulk “Send to CRMax” action lets you push existing users too.
  • Sync WooCommerce customers – paid and processing orders create or update a contact with order totals and lifetime order count.
  • Tag and enrol automatically – every contact from your site gets a default tag, and can be dropped straight into a CRMax workflow (automation) for follow-up.
  • Embed CRMax anywhere with shortcodes for forms, booking calendars and funnel pages.
  • See your CRM at a glance with a WordPress dashboard widget showing contacts, pipeline value, revenue and upcoming bookings.

Shortcodes

  • [crmax_form slug="your-form"] – embed a CRMax form
  • [crmax_booking slug="your-calendar"] – embed a booking calendar
  • [crmax_funnel slug="your-page"] – embed a funnel / landing page

Each accepts an optional height attribute (in pixels).

Requires an account

This plugin is a client for the CRMax platform and requires a CRMax account. Create one free at crmax.au. Data is sent to your CRMax account over HTTPS using the REST API token you provide.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the crmax-connect folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Go to CRMax in the admin menu.
  4. In CRMax, open Settings → API, generate a token, and paste it into the plugin along with your CRMax URL.
  5. Click Test connection to confirm, then choose what to sync.
sections.faq:
Do I need a CRMax account?

Yes. The plugin sends data to your CRMax account via its REST API. You can create a free account at https://crmax.au.

Which form plugins are supported?

Contact Form 7, WPForms, Gravity Forms, Elementor Pro Forms and Fluent Forms. The plugin maps common fields (name, email, phone, company) automatically and stores the rest as custom fields.

What data is sent to CRMax?

Only the contact details captured by your forms, users or WooCommerce orders – such as name, email, phone, company and the fields you collect. Nothing is sent until you enter a valid API token and enable a sync option. See our privacy policy at https://crmax.au for details.

Is it compatible with WooCommerce HPOS?

Yes. The WooCommerce integration uses the official order API and works with High-Performance Order Storage.
